items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: I was also working with a very dear friend of mine, Bobby Troupe... I stayed with Bobby for about five years

ctx.x: That's right, it's just, you know. It was no comparison, you know. But Nat and Sinatra, they are giants, you know, musically. So during this time, as I said, I worked with Sinatra, and I was -- at this time I was also working with a very dear friend of mine, Bobby Troupe. Now, Bobby -- I said to Bobby, look, I'm going to go with Sinatra. I said, John, go and stay, three months, four months, doesn't make any difference. When you're ready to come back just come back.

Bobby Troupe is a very -- as you know he's a very talented man, and he's a very prolific writer. He's a Phi Beta Kappa, right. And he is an actor. But he's primarily a writer now. This was the perfect job for me. I joined Bobby after I joined Nat. Now, this was the perfect job for
